'''Red spinach''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop]]. They can be planted in all seasons, the leaves are edible raw or [[cooking|cooked]], and seeds when cooked.

Because only the leaves are harvested, new seeds cannot be produced and red spinach cannot be grown domestically in a fortress. 

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] red spinach for its ''leaves''.
